script:
$env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","User")
$configDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode"
cd $configDir
"=== installing plugins ==="
npm install opencode-vibeguard opencode-shell-strategy @tarquinen/opencode-dcp @zenobius/opencode-skillful 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5
"=== building dcp (needs build step) ==="
cd "$configDir\node_modules\@tarquinen\opencode-dcp"
npm run build 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5
"=== verifying ==="
Get-ChildItem "$configDir\node_modules" | Select-Object Name | Select-Object -First 10
